title: Take Leave
label: ch:fa-take-leave
canDo: I can open a short Persian conversation, check how the other person is, and close it with khodâ hâfez.

payoff.summary: A four-line interaction with a beginning and an end: salâm, the wellbeing check, then khodâ hâfez from both voices; then the farewell taken apart into khodâ and hâfez, and خدا, حافظ and خداحافظ read off the page.
payoff.note: FA-C05-practice is the chapter's last lesson and assesses all eleven atoms the chapter introduces: the complete interaction, a spoken recall of khodâ and hâfez with their inherited Persian and Arabic origins and the verbless 'God [be] guardian' formula, and a script section reading the two halves and the joined spelling.
